name: Admin MCPs Connectors
description: Superuser manages MCP connectors at /panel/mcps: inspects risk-classified capabilities and requests and domain writes attributed to a non-interactive connector service actor, including document-thread, income-record and card-statement authorship; creates scoped/expiring credentials, edits scope, rotates or revokes each credential through the panel confirmation modal; receives every secret once; preserves the compatibility token and active toggle. Sensitive tools are identified as preview-plus-confirm actions. Server contracts reject malformed transport envelopes, invalid scopes or expiry, stale confirmations and unsafe temporary assets. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel. At compact, portrait, landscape, desktop and wide profiles, credential labels, actors and request IDs remain readable without horizontal overflow; accordion triggers provide touch targets of at least 44px on compact and portrait; scope editing can be opened and cancelled on portrait.
